newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia PSC raises rights to 7-for-2.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia PSC raises rights to 7-for-2.

text.p: Malaysian shipbuilder PSC Industries Bhd has raised a proposed rights issue to seven shares for two existing from an earlier three-for-one.
Its merchant banker said in a statement that the rights issue will be accompanied by a bonus issue, which remains unchanged in the ratio of three shares for every one held.

The rights issue will be at a price of 4.35 ringgit per share and will raise 602.4 million ringgit, it said. PSC's equity will increase to 296.74 million shares from 39.57 million after the two issues.
The issue has been revised to allow PSC, formerly Penang Shipbuilding Corp, take a 48 percent stake in Danish firms Danyard A/S and 40 percent equity in Danyard Aalborg A/S.
The two acquisitions will cost PSC $100 million, the statement said.
